newsitem.title: JAPAN: Nissan Mexico to supply engine parts to U.S. unit.
newsitem.headline: Nissan Mexico to supply engine parts to U.S. unit.

text.p: Nissan Motor Co Ltd said on Wednesday that its Mexican unit will start production of key engine parts in April for Nissan's U.S. unit in order to replace parts currently imported from Japan.
The move is aimed at cutting production costs, and will not entail fresh capital investment in Nissan Mexicana SA de CV, a Nissan spokeswoman said.
The parts are cylinder blocks and camshafts for engines used in the Sentra and 200SX models at Nissan's Tennessee unit, Nissan Motor Manufacturing.
Nissan Mexicana will make engine parts for 10,000 vehicles per month for the U.S. subsidiary, she said.

The Mexican unit currently makes cylinder blocks and camshafts used for a few types of engines, and will be able to supply the parts to the U.S. unit by improving efficiency at its existing facilities, she said.
